# Sales Autonomy

> Sales Autonomy (https://salesautonomy.com) provides 3 Pre-Cleaned Vertical Market Databases for B2B SaaS, Vertical Tech, Mid-Market GTM Teams (5–50 reps), and Clay/Outbound Agencies whose SDRs are starving because Apollo and ZoomInfo miss physical-world facilities, fleet insurance cancellations, clinic owners, and government filings. Every vertical engine is cross-joined against our Shared Corporate Backbone: 700,000+ SAM.gov verified corporate domains (`entityUrl`) and 650,000+ DOL Form 5500 filings (EIN, exact active employee headcount, and CPA-filtered CFO/HR signatories).

## The 3 Pre-Cleaned Vertical Market Engines

1. **Engine 1: Healthcare & Multi-Site Clinic Graph**
   - NPPES Organization Type-2 multi-site groups, extracted `Authorized Official` (Owner/Managing Partner/CMO), state license expansion deltas, patient booking-widget EHR DOM detection (Athenahealth, ModMed EMA, Dentrix), CMS Care Compare F-tag deficiency citations (45-day Plan of Correction windows), and OIG LEIE exclusion flags.
2. **Engine 2: Industrial, Fleet & Facility Risk Graph**
   - FMCSA 5–500+ truck fleets with 100% forward-looking 30-day Form BMC-35 insurance cancellation notices and 60/90-day Form BMC-91X policy renewal anniversaries; newly opened Federal OSHA inspections (`OPEN_DATE`) with 30–90 day abatement deadlines and Repeat-Violation Ex-Mod spike risk; and EPA ECHO enforcement facilities—all cross-joined with our DOL Form 5500 EIN, exact active employee headcount, and CFO/HR Signatory backbone.
3. **Engine 3: Public Sector, Contractors & Permits Graph**
   - SAM.gov daily forward-looking 30/60/90-day `registrationExpirationDate` countdowns, 700K native `entityUrl` verified corporate domains, USAspending contract awards and 60-day recompete windows, and Socrata/ArcGIS commercial building permits >$100K resolved from subsidiary LLCs to parent accounts.

## Universal 6-Table Canonical Postgres / Supabase Schema

Every vault ships with six relational tables guarded by our atomic source-hierarchy trigger (`fn_provenance_update`):
1. `sources_provenance`: 5-tier authority ranking (Tier 1 Federal Statutory > Tier 2 State/Municipal > Tier 3 First-Party DOM > Tier 4 Trade Directories > Tier 5 Web), SHA-256 payload hash receipts, capture timestamps, and verbatim excerpts.
2. `entities`: Canonical corporate spine linking UEI, EIN, NPI-2, USDOT, verified domain, Form 5500 active employee headcount, and `field_provenance_jsonb`.
3. `facilities_sites`: Every physical clinic location, manufacturing plant, fleet terminal, or permitted job site linked to `entity_id`.
4. `compliance_filings`: Dated regulatory filings, Form BMC-35/91X insurance policies, OSHA open inspections, CMS F-tags, SAM expirations, and building permits.
5. `signals_deltas`: DuckDB SHA-256 delta triggers with daily exponential half-life decay `W(t) = W0 * 0.5^(t / half_life)` via `pg_cron`.
6. `contacts`: Corporate officers filtered through our 50-keyword CPA/registered-agent exclusion gate and verified Just-In-Time through Catch-All SMTP to guarantee `<2%` email bounce rate.

## 4 Standardized Delivery Outputs

1. Weekly Digest CSV / Parquet export
2. Isolated Supabase RLS View & PowerTable UI
3. Bi-directional CRM & Clay Webhook push (HubSpot, Salesforce, Clay)
4. Read-only REST API & MCP Server
